title: Giant Hornets Slaughter Hives. These Bees Cook Them Alive
subject: Japanese honeybee

scenes.text: Giant hornets wipe out bee hives. One bee species has a trick: it cooks the hornet.
When a hornet scout arrives, Japanese honeybees swarm it into a tight ball.
They shiver their flight muscles, and the ball's center hits 46 degrees Celsius within five minutes.
A hornet dies at about 47. But the bees' own breath makes carbon dioxide rise to 3.6 percent, and that drops the hornet's limit to 45.
The bees can take 50. The gap is only a few degrees.
About ten minutes later the hornet is dead. The weapon was never a sting. It was temperature.

description:

Japanese honeybees ball around a scout and shiver to reach about 46 degrees Celsius, while their carbon dioxide lowers the hornet's heat limit.
Would you have bet on the bees?
